name: First Contact
source:
First Contact takes place during a fall afternoon at a university just like yours. You play as Naomi- You're hanging out with your roommate Romeo when an alien spaceship crashes into your dorm.  It’s you and Romeo figuring out how to make a good impression on this new creature. Will you become friends? enemies? frenemies?  Will you even get to meet the new guy? 

[from [url=https://firstcontactemda.itch.io/first-contact]Itch.io[/url]]
